title: Another personal AI assistant has launched — Meet Tab, which emerged from stealth with a $300M valuation
key_facts: Meet Tab announced on Tuesday (6 Oct 2026) that it had officially emerged from stealth (secret development) at a $300 million valuation; the company declined to share exact funding details.
Investors in the round include SV Angel, Valar Ventures and American Spirit.
Tab is a personal AI assistant: users text it on iMessage or WhatsApp to order groceries, find gifts, book travel or handle bills.
Ammar Amdani, a co-founder of Meet Tab, says Tab has its own phone number, computer and wallet, and that card details sit in a vault Tab cannot see (company claims).
The company says data is never used to train AI and nothing irreversible happens without the user's 'yes'.
Growth so far is mostly word of mouth; a new product is planned soon.
